text:
Lina (Design): quick sync on a few small-but-visible UI nits noticed in the console: button vertical rhythm, table action column width, and modal close hit targets.
Owen (Frontend): saw the screenshot in the QA ticket. Table rows look off when we enable `--spacing-dense`. Actions jump left 6px.
Priya (A11y): accessibility concerns: icon-only table buttons missing aria-labels; focus ring gets clipped when `overflow: hidden` is applied to row cells.
Marco (Product): users have reported accidental modal closes on touch because the close X is small on mobile. We should increase hit area without changing visual size.
Lina (Design): proposed principles: 1) keep baseline grid consistent across buttons/tables/modals; 2) icon-only controls must have 44px touch targets; 3) focus-visible should always be fully visible (no clipping).
Owen (Frontend): implementation notes: our spacing tokens are used inconsistently: `--space-2` sometimes equals 6px in token set A and 8px in token set B (legacy). That explains the 6px shift. We should normalize tokens and add a `--space-dense` mapping.
Priya (A11y): for focus clipping: avoid `transform` on parent containers where possible, or render focus outlines using an inset box-shadow on the control itself. Use `outline-offset` carefully.
Lina (Design): small CSS example for icon-only buttons (visual size stays 16px, hit target 44px):
```css
.icon-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border-radius: 8px; }
.icon-btn__visual { width: 16px; height: 16px; pointer-events: none; }
.icon-btn:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--color-focus); }
```
Owen (Frontend): will implement a wrapper that keeps visual icon centered while preserving 44px size. Also to fix table layout I suggest making the action column `min-width: 88px` and aligning icons with the baseline token `--space-3`.
Marco (Product): does `min-width: 88px` push other columns too much on narrow tables? We need to assert behavior for tables with many columns.
Lina (Design): for narrow screens we switch to condensed action layout: hide text labels and stack actions in a kebab menu. Add a density breakpoint so desktop keeps 88px, mobile uses 56px.
Priya (A11y): also a11y rule: kebab menu must be keyboard operable and announce "More actions". Add `aria-haspopup` and visible focus.
Owen (Frontend): note about modals: increasing close hit target can be done by expanding the clickable area but not visually increasing the X. I'll add a pseudo-element for hit area: `.modal-close::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -10px; }` plus `pointer-events: auto` on the pseudo. Watch stacking context so it doesn't sit behind the modal.
Lina (Design): spare token suggestion: add `--hit-target-sm`, `--hit-target-md` and document usage rules in the component library.
design-bot: Heads-up: Token rename RFC #5091 pending; changes to `--space-*` may conflict. https://git.mock/rfc/5091
Owen (Frontend): I'll open PR that: 1) normalizes spacing tokens (adds dense mapping), 2) adds icon-button wrapper + docs, 3) sets action column min-width and responsive fallback, 4) increases modal close hit area via pseudo-element. Will include visual regression screenshots.
Marco (Product): acceptance criteria: touch targets >= 44px, focus rings never clipped, table actions aligned with baseline tokens, and no layout regressions on 1024/1366/1440 widths.
Priya (A11y): tests to include: keyboard-only navigation through table actions, high-contrast mode check, mac VoiceOver announce of kebab menu label.
Lina (Design): tiny copy nits for docs: use sentence case, prefer "icon only" vs "icon-only" in prose, and call out the token mappings in a short table.
Owen (Frontend): will aim for draft PR by tomorrow morning and link screenshots.
Lina (Design): thanks, will review and update the component spec then. :sparkles:
